```
webapp@prod-web-03:~$ cat /etc/ssh/sshd_config
# $OpenBSD: sshd_config,v 1.103 2018/04/09 20:41:22 tj Exp $
# Managed by Ansible — role: baseline_ssh — last run 2024-11-02 03:17:44 UTC
# Local edits will be overwritten. Contact infra-ops@meridian-ctx.example

Include /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/*.conf

Port 54177
AddressFamily inet
ListenAddress 10.48.12.37
ListenAddress 127.0.0.1

Protocol 2
HostKey /etc/ssh/ssh_host_rsa_key
HostKey /etc/ssh/ssh_host_ecdsa_key
HostKey /etc/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key

# Ciphers and keying
RekeyLimit 512M 6h
Ciphers chacha20-poly1305@openssh.com,aes256-gcm@openssh.com,aes128-gcm@openssh.com
MACs hmac-sha2-512-etm@openssh.com,hmac-sha2-256-etm@openssh.com
KexAlgorithms curve25519-sha256,curve25519-sha256@libssh.org,diffie-hellman-group18-sha512

# Logging
SyslogFacility AUTHPRIV
LogLevel VERBOSE

# Authentication
LoginGraceTime 30
PermitRootLogin no
StrictModes yes
MaxAuthTries 3
MaxSessions 4

PubkeyAuthentication yes
AuthorizedKeysFile      .ssh/authorized_keys .ssh/authorized_keys2
PasswordAuthentication no
PermitEmptyPasswords no
ChallengeResponseAuthentication no
KerberosAuthentication no
GSSAPIAuthentication no

AllowUsers webapp deploy ci-runner backup-svc
DenyUsers admin root oracle test

AllowAgentForwarding no
AllowTcpForwarding yes
PermitTunnel no
X11Forwarding no
PrintMotd no
PrintLastLog yes
TCPKeepAlive yes
ClientAliveInterval 300
ClientAliveCountMax 2
MaxStartups 10:30:60
Banner /etc/ssh/banner.corp

AcceptEnv LANG LC_*
Subsystem       sftp    internal-sftp -l VERBOSE -f LOCAL5

# --- jump-host chaining (per CR-2291) ---
Match User backup-svc
    ForceCommand internal-sftp
    ChrootDirectory /srv/backup/jail
    AllowTcpForwarding no

Match Address 10.48.0.0/16
    MaxAuthTries 5
```
